name: OK-VQA
description: Open-Ended Knowledgeable Visual Question Answering (OK-VQA) is a dataset of questions about images that require external knowledge beyond the visual content to answer. The dataset uses images from COCO; this record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Marino, K., Rastegari, M., Farhadi, A., & Mottaghi, R. (2019). OK-VQA: A Visual Question Answering Benchmark Requiring External Knowledge. IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 3195–3204. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2019.00331

license.identifier: Not stated (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The upstream dataset site does not clearly state a dataset-wide license. Images are sourced from COCO and have their own underlying rights; review upstream terms and image licenses before use or redistribution.
